sets.dir: Questions 131–134 refer to the following notice.
sets.passage_html:
Notice — Lobby Renovation

Posted by Building Management · March 3

Beginning Monday, contractors will renovate the main lobby. The work is expected to last approximately two weeks. During this period, employees should enter through the west side door.

_____(131)_____ the construction zone will be clearly marked with barriers. Please do not cross into restricted areas.

Elevator service to floors 2–8 will remain normal. _____(132)_____ the service elevator may be reserved for construction crews between 9:00 a.m. and noon.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your _____(133)_____. For questions, contact Facilities at ext. 4400. An updated schedule will be _____(134)_____ on the intranet each Friday.

questions.rationale: 承接上文补充说明施工区会有围挡标识 → Additionally。
电梯正常 vs 服务梯可能被征用，转折用 However。
被动 be + 过去分词 → posted。

sets.zh_passage:
通知——大堂翻新
自周一起承包商将翻新主大堂，预计约两周。期间员工请走西侧门进入。此外，施工区将有围挡清晰标识，请勿进入限制区域。2–8 层电梯正常；但服务电梯在上午 9:00–12:00 可能供施工队使用。造成不便敬请见谅，感谢您的耐心。有问题请打分机 4400。更新日程将于每周五发布在内网。
